descriptions.w3d_d24a_commentary_kills_800468dc: Takes and clears the kill counter (+256); when the commentary is enabled (+252), the counter is non-zero and the active worm index (+128) is a valid player, discounts one kill if word +220 of the player record is 0, picks a Comment.nKill string (0x800fc2b0) from a random number by the kill count, formats it with the record name if it contains %s (0x8020c510) and plays it (0x80043134).
